text_block_list.text:
Walking down the hallway, I heard voices 
arguing coming from one of the rooms. 
Worried, I peeked inside—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, come now, don't be shy! Take a 
bite! In one single go!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, I refuse. You're plotting something... 
aren't you...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not plotting a thing! As I've been 
saying, this is a genuine, 100% pure 
gesture of goodwill!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a visitor! How rare! But what a stroke 
of luck! You help me convince Cafe, won't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even though I went through the trouble of 
preparing delicious cookies for Cafe, she 
stubbornly refuses to eat them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I do like cookies... But... 
Tachyon-san's kindness almost always has 
an ulterior motive...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why would you say that~? These are 
ordinary cookies without any drugs spiked 
in them~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The flavors are perfectly normal too: 
plain, coffee, chocolate, matcha, and 
super-spicy pepper sauce—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Oops.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, it's fine, I didn't lie. There 
are genuinely no pharmaceuticals involved. 
It's merely a Russian roulette of flavors.
choice_data_list: Why on earth would you do that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It should be obvious—for an experiment, of 
course!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you heard as well? That from time 
to time, phenomena inexplicable by modern 
science occur around Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, I stand firmly opposed to 
defining something as non-existent merely 
because it cannot be explained!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, observing and defining 
"that thing" presumed to stem from Cafe's 
surprise or anger—that is the proper 
scientific path to pursue right now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so, I figured the quickest way was to 
startle her with an unexpected taste, but—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please don't... Doing that... just out of 
idle curiosity...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, what's wrong with pure curiosity? I 
suspect the existence of your "friend" is 
what grants you your power.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If this "communion" between you and your 
"friend" holds the key for horse girls to 
surpass their limits—!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They are... my precious "friend"... You 
mustn't approach them with improper 
motives...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course I have no intention of being 
disrespectful, but to overlook a 
reproducible, unexplored phenomenon right 
before my eyes would make me a failure as 
a researcher—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Look... they're angry.

As if responding to Manhattan Cafe's 
words, the room began to shake even 
violently—!
(WHOOOOOOOSH—!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a reaction far exceeding 
expectations! This is the paranormal 
phenomenon caused by Cafe's "friend"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! No need to hold back, feel free 
to give me even more of a greeting!

Agnes Tachyon seemed eager to provoke the 
phenomena swirling around the room even 
further, but—
choice_data_list: No, this is just a coincidence!
No, this is just a coincidence!

Anything more than this is getting truly 
terrifying...

terrifying...

phenomena swirling around the room even 
further, but—

text_block_list.text:
I told her that because we hadn't shut the 
door when entering the room, it was 
probably just the wind blowing in.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Have your friends ever told you 
that you lack a sense of humor?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, no matter. We managed an intriguing 
observation. Let us leave it at a greeting 
for today, and next time I shall witness 
the full power of your paranormal 
phenomena!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I told you... no... Jeez... Why won't you 
listen to me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying, this was a massive 
success! If we keep advancing the 
experiment like this, perhaps—
D O N O T I N T E R F E R E

An eerie sound reached our ears. Unless it 
was my imagination, it sounded almost like 
someone's voice—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... magnificent, simply moving! How can 
I approach the presence of this "friend" 
even further?

Was that really the voice of the "friend" 
we heard? While I stood terrified, Agnes 
Tachyon was utterly thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous! More importantly, 
take this chance to feed Cafe the cookie! 
Surely there will be even more of a 
reaction—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... If you insist on pushing this... 
I'll pour the most bitter coffee I can 
brew... straight down your throat...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Attempting negotiations at a time like 
this? However, if it is for the sake of 
research, I'd gladly—!
(WHOOOOSH—!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aah! My precious super-spicy pepper sauce 
cookie!

Another gust of wind blew Agnes Tachyon's 
cookie away. Sensing the presence of the 
unseen "friend," it proved to be quite a 
terrifying ordeal.
